intent_snapshot.goal: remove-redundant-checks S6 (Spec docs/specs/remove-redundant-checks.spec.md, Technical Design S6 and threat model; U2, U3). The Review coordinator parser drops caller-side checks that a rebuild or a retained check already covers: B1 unknown-field rejection on finding evidence, evidence.violated, incomplete, pass approval and finding; B4 rework approval rejection; B5 approval kind and role self-assertion; B6 the empty-id trim; B7 the duplicate verification identity check; B11 the security-boundary revalidation and second git show, keeping the missing-boundary throw. The child-verdict top-level and verifier-output unknown-field checks stay. The Kernel receives the same verdict for every input accepted today. Execution posture: characterization-first.

acceptance.assertion: In tests/pi-canary-assurance-authority.test.ts and tests/pi-canary-assurance-progression.test.ts, a verdict with one extra field on finding evidence, evidence.violated, an incomplete verdict, a pass approval or a finding parses and the result carries no extra field; a QA finding carrying evidence parses without evidence; an extra top-level child-verdict field still throws unknown field; a missing trigger, caller_chain or approval summary still throws its current message.

In tests/pi-canary-assurance-authority.test.ts, a rework verdict carrying an approval object parses to a rework verdict without approval; a pass approval with a wrong kind or authority_role parses to the expected kind and role; a finding id of spaces parses to a regenerated id; a non-string id and an empty approval summary still throw.

In tests/host-neutral-assurance-coordinator.test.ts, the verification packet for a rework verdict with an acceptance finding and one with a security_boundary finding equals the packet built before the change; an unknown boundary ref still throws security boundary source is invalid; verifier output with an extra field still discards the whole output and keeps every finding.
bun run typecheck passes over the whole repository after the change, so no remaining import, re-export or call names a deleted or changed symbol.

attestations.summary: Every removed parser check is covered by something the change keeps: the parse functions rebuild verdict, approval, finding, evidence and incomplete objects from named fields only. reviewSecurityBoundarySources still reads the boundary line from the immutable review_commit. Finding ids embed their index, so they cannot collide. Tests pin the packet, the strict top-level whitelist and the kept messages. The two coordinator copies are identical blobs and both dist bundles match them. Blast radius: medium; the load-bearing path is runtime/assurance/coordinator.ts (Review verdict parsing and the verifier packet) and no persisted shape changes.
